description: Restructure the Phase I Environmental Site Assessment (ESA) report at '/home/ga/Documents/esa_draft.docx'. The current document is a single section with uniform formatting. You must: (1) Save the file as '/home/ga/Documents/esa_formatted.docx'. (2) Insert section breaks to create at least four distinct sections: 'Cover Page', 'Body' (starts at Executive Summary), 'Site Maps/Data' (starts at Site Maps and Data Tables), and 'Appendices'. (3) Change the page orientation of the 'Site Maps/Data' section to Landscape (keep others Portrait). (4) Configure headers: The Cover Page must have NO header; the Body, Data, and Appendices sections must have a header containing 'ESA-2024-0472' and 'Former Kerrigan Manufacturing Facility'.
